findings.check: resumeConsentedStartup returns while privacy consent is absent and again while onboarding is incomplete
rule refresh, favicon network resolution, entitlement synchronization and external-open subscription start only after both gates
all event writes require telemetry to be enabled; initial and unresolved-consent states suppress writes
initialize creates only the local cache directory; network work starts from iconFor after the consent gate
crash observers can register before consent but cannot write while telemetry remains disabled

limitations: A fresh-data physical-device network and app-event trace is still required before this case can pass.
